column1: # route-owners.tsv — ordered seeding rules for the fixture's `owner` column.
# Format: regex<TAB>owner<TAB>rationale   (regex matches anywhere in the path)
# FIRST MATCH WINS — keep the order meaningful when editing.
# Used by scripts/gen_upstream_routes.py --owner-rules, which only fills in
# owner cells that are still EMPTY; an explicit owner in
# docs/fixtures/upstream-routes.tsv always wins, so hand-written corrections are
# never silently overwritten.  Rationale + vocabulary: docs/22-ROUTE-PARITY.md.
